business.name: Long Stretch Physio
business.what: A private physiotherapy practice in rented rooms in Brunswick.
business.structure: A sole trader with an ABN. Daisy drops to two days at Bayview Health, then leaves on 30 June 2033.
business.gst: Allied health services are often GST-free. A physiotherapy consultation that is necessary treatment carries no GST, but GST-free sales still count towards the $75,000 registration threshold, so the practice registers and lodges anyway. Braces and bands sold at the desk, and ergonomic assessments for employers, are taxable.
business.bas: Quarterly, most of the income at the GST-free label.
business.caution: A sketch for a chapter, not tax advice. Check the rule when chapter 7 is built.
